No floor, scenery, stairs, labels, text, grid lines or shadows under feet. Every cell has generous empty gutters and complete head, hands and feet. Keep fixed character scale and foot baseline across a row; animate limbs and posture, do not translate the character across cells. Columns 5-8: four sequential poses ASCENDING stairs diagonally up-right, three-quarter rear view, lean forward slightly, alternate high knee and planted lower foot, believable upward effort. Columns 9-12: four sequential poses DESCENDING stairs diagonally down-right, three-quarter front view, careful lower-reaching foot and counterbalancing arms, clearly different from flat walking. Do not draw stairs: the game supplies the exact staircase under their feet. Small carried tools remain identifiable but are held safely near the body during movement.
